name: sfeed
description: Publish, schedule, inspect, and manage reviewed Facebook Page and Instagram content through the local sfeed CLI and MCP server.

interface.longDescription: sfeed gives Codex a local workflow for checking connected Facebook Pages and Instagram accounts, validating media, publishing reviewed content, managing Page posts, and scheduling posts through the sfeed MCP server.
